label: D-LINK DPN-100 Rev A2 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, 64 MB RAM / 8 MB flash) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over no published management.
